messages:
Priya Nair: @Jared FYI — customer acme-inc opened a support case: their client sees repeated parsing failures when using json_mode=true. Server returns 200 but client JSON.parse throws. Repro below.

Priya Nair: Repro (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-large","prompt":"generate config","json_mode":true,"json_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"}}}}'
```

Priya Nair: Response body (what the client got):
```
{\"name\":\"acme-app\",}
```
(note trailing comma -> invalid JSON)

Priya Nair: Request headers include x-request-id=req_abc123 and trace: https://console.redwood.ai/trace/req_abc123

Support Bot: Alert: structured-output-parse-rate for route /v1/generate > 0.015 for namespace acme-inc (5m) :warning:

Jared Lopez: thanks — can you paste the raw server logs (redacted) or paste the trace events? need model, route, and any token-level output. Also is this only for this customer or widespread?

Priya Nair: only saw in acme-inc's tenant so far. Attaching trimmed logs:
```
[2026-05-01T15:20:12Z] req=req_abc123 model=redwood-2-large route=/v1/generate json_mode=true output_tokens=34 
  token_chunk: '{\"name\":\"acme-app\",'
  token_chunk: '\\n'
  finalization: 'EOF'
```

Priya Nair: They have strict client-side JSON parse which fails the whole feature branch. Billing unaffected but they reported latency spikes afterwards as client retries.

Sophie Turner: :eyes: we should capture a structured_parse_failure metric with tags: model, route, customer_id, failure_type (malformed_token, truncation, tokenizer_split). Also increment per-request sample so we can calculate % of structured requests failing.

Alex Chen: agree. Also proposal: emit a per-request event to traces with span attribute structured_parse_status=(ok|fail) and include a redacted preview of the last 64 bytes of output (no PII). That will make dashboards and traces useful without leaking data.

Jared Lopez: +1. Quick mitigation: server should offer a lenient-json-mode header (X-Redwood-JSON-Mode: lenient) which returns a wrapped response when parsing fails, e.g. 200 with JSON: {"structured_output":null, "parse_error":"trailing_comma","raw_preview":"{...}"}. That avoids breaking clients immediately. But this is a product change — need eng + product signoff.

Priya Nair: Customer asked for workaround: can we add a route-level fallback? e.g., return content-type: application/json and include an envelope. They said they can toggle on their side but want platform fix.

Observability Team: Proposal for dashboards:
- Panel: structured_parse_failures / total_structured_requests (5m) by route and customer_id
- Heatmap: failure_type distribution (last 24h)
- Alert: rate > 0.01 for > 10m with severity=P2 -> pages on-call SRE
- Trace link: surface latest failing trace in incident view (link to /trace/<id>)

Sophie Turner: Also add log redaction rule to mask prompt content and emails/SSNs before storing in logs. Use tags: redacted:true. We should make that opt-out for Private deployments.

Jared Lopez: I can take ownership. Action items I will do today:
1) add a counter metric structured_parse_failures{route,model,customer_id,failure_type}
2) add trace span attribute structured_parse_status and raw_preview (redacted, trunc 64)
3) create default dashboard panels and an alert rule in Grafana -> Config PR
4) sketch server-side lenient-json-mode design doc and a safety rollout plan

Priya Nair: :thumbsup: please include steps for customer-facing temporary mitigation (how to enable envelope mode) so Support can guide acme-inc.

Jared Lopez: will send a PR in infra-observability and a support KB draft. Ticket: INC-4567 created. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/obs/+/789 (WIP). Assigning to Observability Team and Eng SRE.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: infra-observability branch=feature/structured-parse-metrics -> staging on 2026-05-01T18:00:00Z

Alex Chen: quick note re: metrics cardinality: avoid full customer_id in metrics stream for high-card customers. Use hashed_customer_bucket or sample top 100 by traffic. We'll add a tag customer_bucket:hashed(sha1(customer_id)) and expose full customer_id in traces only.

Priya Nair: Customer reply: thanks, they'll hold off on client change if we can provide envelope fallback within 48h. Also happy to be alpha tester.

Jared Lopez: ack. I'm setting target to have metric + dashboard + a non-breaking envelope fallback prototype in staging within 48h. Will update this thread with PR links and a short runbook for Support to enable the fallback per-tenant.

Observability Team: noted. We'll add a dashboard panel and a runbook playbook for triage (how to find traces, how to correlate with billing/latency spikes).

Priya Nair: thanks all. Filing the support case update now.

Jared Lopez: created INC-4567, added labels: structured-output, observability, customer-impact, priority=P2. Follow-ups: Sophie (redaction rules), Alex (cardinality plan), Observability Team (dash + alert). Will post updates here. :rocket:
